mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him he has been given a three-year window for a major revival and the greatest harvest of souls the world has seen, asks whether they will help with the harvest, and says a lot of people are upset and ready to jump ship.
mentions.quote: I've given you a three-year window for a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A documented revival of that scale within three years.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. No start date is given, so the three years cannot be timed.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in his heart he is praying for a three and a half year window for a major revival and a major harvest of souls around that time frame, that nobody knows the day or the hour and he is not saying he does, but that they were told to watch the fig tree and the signs and can sense the year and the month.
mentions.quote: I'm praying for a three and a half year window for a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: A revival of that scale in that span.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He marks this as his own prayer rather than as a word, and disclaims knowing the day or the hour.
